versions.content: The FiM module shall calculate the inhibit status based on the actual status of the inhibit source and the calibrated mask which exists for each inhibit source (ref. 10.2.7). The FiM module shall inhibit the FID if the Monitor status is equal to the calibrated mask (=Defect, Tested, NotTested). The inhibition is deactivated if the mask of the event does not match anymore the calibrated value.
